exposure: Exposure of the mother to smoke
cohort: 823 children diagnosed with OSAS and 823 children without OSAS, matched for age, gender, and body mass index
finding: Preterm birth, cesarean section, and maternal smoking were significantly associated with OSAS in children.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with OSAS in children (aOR: 1.32, 95% CI: 1.03-1.68).
